# Exactly-once Kafka transaction for aggregates and offsets

> Aggregates clicks per minute and commits them with consumer offsets in a single Kafka transaction, re-delivering the batch on failure.

_Part of [Aggregating and billing ad clicks](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md)_

Clicks flow from [Ad click tokens and fraud checks](ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md) into Kafka's `ads.clicks` topic, where [`ClickAggregator`](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md) reads them in batches. The service groups each batch's clicks by campaign and minute (counting valid vs invalid clicks), then atomically writes the aggregates to `ads.click-aggregates` and commits the consumer group's offset in a single Kafka transaction. If anything fails during the transaction—parsing, sending aggregates, sending offsets—the entire transaction aborts. No aggregates become visible to `read_committed` readers. The batch is re-delivered from the last committed offset, and the aggregator processes it again. Because each aggregate is keyed by campaign, minute, partition, and first offset of the batch, re-delivering a batch safely overwrites the prior aggregates instead of duplicating them. The exactly-once guarantee holds: each click is counted exactly once across failures and restarts.

**Look at:** [`ClickAggregator` in click-aggregator.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/infra/click-aggregator.service.ts#L43)

## Pieces

- [Atomic write of aggregates and consumer offset in one Kafka transaction](transactional-offset-commit.md): A Kafka transaction sends minute aggregates to `ads.click-aggregates`, then commits the consumer group's offset for the batch—or aborts both if anything fails.
- [Batch partition and first offset in each aggregate for safe re-writes](idempotent-batch-keying.md): Each aggregate includes `source_partition` and `first_offset` so that re-delivering a batch replaces the prior aggregates instead of duplicating.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| queue | `ads.clicks` | Source topic; [`ClickAggregator`](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md) consumer reads click records in batches. |
| queue | `ads.click-aggregates` | Destination topic; minute aggregates are written atomically with the consumer offset. |

## Watch out

- `readUncommitted: false` on the consumer: only see aggregates from committed transactions, never partial writes from aborted transactions.
- Transaction abort re-delivers the batch from the last committed offset—exactly-once depends on downstream consumers being idempotent.
- The `transactionalId` includes hostname and PID; if a producer with the same ID restarts, fencing aborts its prior incomplete transactions.
- Heartbeat is called after the transaction commits; if processing takes longer than the heartbeat interval, the batch is rebalanced and re-read.
